summary: $45 for 2026 confirmed; season Apr 15-Oct 14 from the village page; reservable by phone; 72 sites, 50 ft and 20-amp cleared (note only); public can book a night, but seasonal in character.
flags: LOCAL: the public can book an ordinary night: $45 'Daily' posted for 2026, reservations through the manager. Presence: village page live, 440-224-0310. RV Life 4*.

LONG-STAY (test 4): page prices Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Seasonal, carries a mail notice for 'Campground Patrons' and asks for unpaid 2025 electric bills before re-entry. 6/2025 RV Life camper ($45, rating 6): 'an old city park which seems mainly populated with seasonal campers. Some are in need of a serious cleaning with green mold or moss growing on them. It has good power and water, but the dump' (cut off by the API). 7/2022 camper: 'basic and quiet at night ... as are the seasonal campers I spoke with'. Share not posted. Test 2 passes on the posted daily rate; test 4 needs a human call.

PAGE SILENT: the page doesn't give amps, site count, rig length, pool or the dump. Pull-through stays as stored: a 5/2025 camper reports one. 7/2022 motorhome camper stayed at back-in site 29 (rig length not given). 20-amp was cleared; 6/2025 camper says 'good power', no figure.

PIN: Esri imagery has a cloud over the pin; a block of roughly 30 settled rigs shows ~170 m NNE at about 41.9212,-80.6879, and the rest is under the cloud, so the pin couldn't be judged. Golf course pond ~200 m W of the pin; no pads seen on it; stored not waterfront stands. Website link is a query-string URL and works.
